description: This file defines the class pBarcode128 used for generating Code 128 barcodes, including encoding, size calculation, and drawing methods. It loads a barcode database and provides barcode rendering functionalities.

classes.name: pBarcode128
classes.description: A class to create and render Code 128 barcodes, with methods for encoding strings, calculating size, and drawing the barcode.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads barcode pattern data from a database file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the projected size of a barcode for a given string and format.

methods.name: encode128
methods.description: Encodes a string into the Code 128 barcode pattern and computes CRC.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode onto a specified object including optional legend and area drawing.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the leftmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a specified position for a specified length.
